note: lablab.ai's own hackathon board, read anonymously. Every open event is taken: only about ten are open at once, so there is nothing to filter against. The prize is read from each detail page, not the listing, because six of ten listings omit it and those six include the largest sponsors. Dates only, no clock times, same as Devpost. Hybrid events are treated as online because the build phase is.
